name: Himeno Chitose
source:
A sweet, innocent, and earnest girl. She’s kind and very caring, but she gets quite jealous.

She attends the same school and is in the same class as Kazuki, who recently transferred there. She’s always looking out for the protagonist.

[From [url=https://www.interheart.co.jp/pcgame/premiumbox/soft/boin/]official site[/url]]
